check_failure.text: In runReview, a check that runs and fails returns exitCode 1 before reviewClient.review is called; main returns that exit code.

invalid_evidence.text: If reviewClient.review throws, including parseResponse rejecting a missing, unexpected, or malformed answer, runReview returns review unavailable, exitCode 2, and no findings.

advisory_only.text: A completed runReview always returns exitCode 0; finding verdicts never change the checks status or the exit code.

sandbox_isolation.text: buildBubblewrapArgs always passes --clearenv, adds --unshare-net unless request.network is true, and emits exactly one writable --bind: request.cwd at /workspace.

selected_paths.text: loadConfig rejects absolute, traversal, glob, and sensitive paths, and collectState applies the same reviewablePath check to every file expanded from a selected folder.
